__comment: Packet B1 / roadmap §3.7: the per-asset `limit` flag. This instrument authors `limit: false`, and its patch is deliberately hot — two unit-amplitude oscillators summed into the output peak at 2.0 — so the golden pins the opt-out shape: <Foo>_process returns `output_left * p.volume, ...` RAW, with no skald_soft_limit call, and the emission carries the 'deliberately unclamped' comment. Every other fixture in the suite omits the flag and therefore pins the default (limited) shape; F-C2-1 measured the manual's canonical patch at 3.93 on exactly this unclamped path.
